sentences.text: Bruce Frederick Joseph Springsteen -LRB- born September 23 , 1949 -RRB- is an American singer-songwriter .
He is known for his work with the E Street Band .	E Street Band	E Street Band

Nicknamed `` The Boss '' , Springsteen is widely known for his brand of poetic lyrics , Americana , working class and sometimes political sentiments centered on his native New Jersey , his distinctive voice , and his lengthy and energetic stage performances -- with concerts from the 1970s to the present decade running at up to four hours in length .	Americana	Americana	working class	Working class in the United States
Springsteen 's recordings have included both commercially accessible rock albums and more somber folk-oriented works .
His most successful studio albums , Born to Run -LRB- 1975 -RRB- and Born in the U.S.A. -LRB- 1984 -RRB- , find pleasures in the struggles of daily American life .	Born to Run	Born to Run
He has sold more than 120 million records worldwide and more than 64 million records in the United States , making him one of the world 's best-selling artists of all time .

He has earned numerous awards for his work , including 20 Grammy Awards , two Golden Globes , and an Academy Award as well as being inducted into both the Songwriters Hall of Fame and the Rock And Roll Hall Of Fame in 1999 .	Rock	Rock music	Golden Globes	Golden Globes	Academy Award	Academy Award	Songwriters Hall of Fame	Songwriters Hall of Fame	Rock And Roll Hall Of Fame	Rock And Roll Hall Of Fame

In 2009 , Springsteen was a Kennedy Center Honors recipient , in 2013 was named MusiCares person of the year and in 2016 was awarded the Presidential Medal of Freedom .	Kennedy Center Honors	Kennedy Center Honors	MusiCares	MusiCares	Presidential Medal of Freedom	Presidential Medal of Freedom
He married Patti Scialfa in 1991 , and the couple have had three children -- Evan James , Jessica Rae and Sam Ryan .	Patti Scialfa	Patti Scialfa	Jessica Rae	Jessica Springsteen
